_doc: tools/build_ganapatha_full.py — data/inputs/ganapatha_full.json: every gaṇa of the Gaṇapāṭha (ashtadhyayi.com, via the brain) in SLP1.

gaNasUtra.dev: शुनः संप्रसारणं वा च दीर्घत्वं, तत्संनियोगेन चान्तोदात्तत्वम्
gaNasUtra.slp1: SunaH saMprasAraRaM vA ca dIrGatvaM tatsaMniyogena cAntodAttatvam

derived.evidence: Kāśikā 6.2.131 vargyādayaḥ … dig-ādiṣu varga pūga gaṇa pakṣa ity evamādayo ye paṭhitāḥ, ta eva yat-pratyayāntāḥ

haritAdiH.evidence: Kāśikā 4.1.100 haritādir bidādyantargaṇaḥ (the stretch from harita to the end of bidādi)

kaRvAdiH.evidence: Kaumudī 4.2.111 'kaṇvo gargādiḥ': kaṇva is a member of gargādi, kaṇvādi is the stretch from kaṇva to its end (kurvādi's gaṇasūtra: kaṇvādivat)

pUrvAdiH.evidence: Kāśikā 7.1.16 pūrvādibhyo navabhyaḥ: the nine from pūrva in sarvādi's order

qatarAdiH.evidence: Kāśikā 7.1.25 ḍatarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ: ḍatara ḍatama anya anyatara itara (sarvādi's five)

indrajananAdiH.evidence: Kāśikā 4.3.88 indrajananādir ākṛtigaṇaḥ prayogato 'nusartavyaḥ, prātipadikeṣu na paṭhyate: usage-attested, not in the pāṭha; admitted only through a reviewed extension row
